screenshots.alt: A blue gate swirls at the end of a stone corridor. Terry faces it with three monsters lined up behind him.
screenshots.caption: Through the Travelers’ Gates

screenshots.alt: Items is selected in the field menu. Beneath Terry’s party, Sura, Onion, and Sky each have a green HP bar and a blue MP bar with current and maximum values.
screenshots.caption: Sura, Onion, and Sky are ready to go

screenshots.alt: Terry sits at a square table with three monsters, including two blue slimes. One tells him, “Everything is best in moderation!”
screenshots.caption: A little table talk

screenshots.alt: Atlas’s field skills include Seek. Its description reads “Examines the area around you,” and the menu shows a cost of 2 MP.
screenshots.caption: Let Atlas take a look

screenshots.alt: Two trainers face each other across the Arena, each with three monsters. Terry’s rival says, “I don’t see how you can win with monsters like those!”
screenshots.caption: Big talk before the Arena battle

screenshots.alt: A multicolored Dragon Quest Monsters 1 & 2 logo sits on a parchment scroll above the English subtitle, The Starry Night Hero and Friends at the Ranch.
screenshots.caption: The adventures begin

screenshots.alt: Terry stands beside two rows of four red-and-gold treasure chests. A dark hole opens in the floor between the rows.
screenshots.caption: Eight treasure chests. Which one first?

screenshots.alt: Terry’s Information screen lists 16:40 of play time, 10 farm monsters, four eggs, three barn monsters, nine gates cleared, and 70 species found.
screenshots.caption: Nine gates down, 70 species found

screenshots.alt: Three enemies face the party, including a knight riding a green slime. Fight is highlighted above Items, Tactics, and Run Away.
screenshots.caption: A little courage. A few good monsters.

screenshots.alt: Terry and three monsters follow a narrow strip of rock between red lava and a brown shoreline. Bare trees dot the path.
screenshots.caption: Single file along the lava flow

screenshots.alt: Terry stands on a blue carpet before the king’s gold throne. The king tells him, “You do things on a grand scale!”
screenshots.caption: An audience with the king

screenshots.alt: Terry faces a green monster with a blade. Broken pots line the cave walls as the monster asks, “What have you done...?!”
screenshots.caption: Who broke all those pots?

screenshots.alt: Terry speaks to a crowned figure at a tea table in a room lined with portraits and flowers. The dialogue reads, “I am satisfied. Terry, win the championship!”
screenshots.caption: A championship to chase

screenshots.alt: Terry turns toward the gray monster across the table. It warns, “All around us! We’d better run away quickly...”
screenshots.caption: Knowing when to run

screenshots.alt: Terry looks across the table toward an antlered monster. Its advice reads, “I’ll go along with everyone. It’s important to stick together.”
screenshots.caption: Better together

screenshots.alt: Terry turns toward the purple winged monster at the foot of the table. Its verdict reads, “Healing just wastes time! Blast it all!”
screenshots.caption: “Healing just wastes time! Blast it all!”

screenshots.alt: A blue crystal ball rests on a red table by a flower-lined balcony. Across the water, a single tree stands on the horizon.
screenshots.caption: The lone tree beyond the castle balcony
